title.narrative: SASA IVI DRC – Elimination of Tuberculosis Kasaï/ Eastern Congo

description.narrative: (Democratic Republic of the Congo): .SASA IVI - Elimination of Tuberculosis (TB) is one of two USAID activities in the DRC that is a part of the Local Organizations Network. In support of USAID's Global Accelerator to End Tuberculosis, this activity strengthens TB prevention, care, and treatment in six DRC provinces (Kasai Central, Kasai Oriental, Lomami, Sankuru, South Kivu, and Tanganyika) through sub-awards with five local organizations that span civil society organizations, faith-based organizations, private sector service delivery providers, and academic institutions. USAID will provide technical assistance to these local organizations to implement locally generated solutions to improve TB diagnosis, treatment, and prevention..With FY 2022 funds, SASA IVI - Elimination of TB will facilitate new TB partnerships, foster inclusiveness, and promote advocacy, empowerment, and accountability for improved TB services in the DRC. Partnerships under this activity will strengthen local capacity to provide quality, equitable, and lifesaving TB services. This will be achieved by mobilizing and leveraging local resources to reach National TB Program targets and promoting more self-reliant, sustainable, and country-owned TB programming in the DRC...This activity will contribute to Mission Objective 4.1 (Strengthen institutional and community capacity to prevent outbreaks from becoming pandemics as well as respond to and overcome frequent public health and humanitarian emergencies) by increasing country capacity, ownership, and accountability towards a more sustainable and effective TB program for the Congolese population. This activity strengthens DRC's capacity to prevent, detect, and respond to infectious diseases, thereby benefiting U.S. national security interests, and advances USAID's Localization Agenda.... .
